rule CobaltStrike_Shellcode {
    meta:
        description = "Detects encoded Cobalt Strike shellcode patterns in memory or dumps"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        tlp = "amber"
    strings:
        $a = { 60 00 00 00 48 89 E2 48 8B D1 48 8B F9 48 8B CA } // Beacon config marker
        $b = "CryptAcquireContext" fullword ascii
        $c = "VirtualAlloc" fullword ascii
        $d = "CreateThread" fullword ascii
    condition:
        all of them
}
